audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the chart disagrees with the page's own prose. Rows 0-5 give Trundle or Skill while whys[0] calls Level 1 even and whys[1] through whys[5] describe Maokai winning every stage; row 6 reads Skill while whys[6], spikes[3] and the late block all say Trundle reclaims the lane at two items. The lane is also rated TRICKY 7.5/10 on a 66.67% win rate.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill / Maokai x5 / Trundle — Trundle has no gap-closer against a 14s targeted Twisted Advance, and only Subjugate's resist-steal flips the duel late.
audit.corrected: All seven rows re-set as one atomic group with matched content pairs and ratings; difficulty moved to 5/10, diff to FAV, tone to amber.

audit.why: Four spikes present: the 2-3 root window, level-6 Nature's Grasp as gank setup, the first-item hold, and Trundle's 2+ item Subjugate scaling. The mirror's cooldown comparison (Nature's Grasp 130/110/90 vs Subjugate 120/100/80) is consistent with it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d say only 'Steals your stats. Respect it.' Nothing states Chomp's flat 3.5s attack-damage sap with an auto reset, Frozen Domain's healing amplification, or that Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain that body-blocks Twisted Advance.
audit.why: Riot's texts: Chomp saps Attack Damage; Frozen Domain gives 'increased healing from all sources while on it' (18s at rank 1); Pillar of Ice 'becoming impassable terrain' (21s at rank 1); Subjugate 120/100/80 doubles the steal over 4 seconds.
audit.corrected: Chomp, Frozen Domain, Pillar of Ice and real cooldowns written into tldr, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mirror's headline fact applies here too: Sap Magic's cooldown drops every time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, so a Trundle chipping you with a 3.5s Chomp is accelerating your own heal.
audit.why: Straight from Maokai's passive text. It reframes the attrition — his poke pays for your sustain, and Grievous Wounds plus burst is what breaks his.
audit.corrected: Not written this pass; every prose slot with room was spent on the ability corrections. Recorded for a follow-up.

notes: The full chart was rebuilt because the old one inverted the page: the prose says Maokai owns Levels 2 through first item and loses only the 2+ item duel, and a 66.67% win rate over 36 games agrees.
